title: Anthropic Just Fixed The #1 Claude Code Problem!
description:
Tell me I'm wrong in the comments, I hate clicking "approve" every 2 seconds lol.

Clicking approve is not safety.

50 prompts in, you're catching about 5% of what Claude drops.

In two days Anthropic flips auto mode on by default.

AI Weekly tested 1,000+ paid users. Auto caught 89% of dangerous commands. We caught 13.6%.

Been on dangerously-skip-permissions since day one. Zero issues.

Click yes enough times, you click yes always.
